description: On the bed in front of you there’s a paper cup with a toothbrush standing in it and a small tube of toothpaste lying nearby. The right hand reaches to the cup and lifts the toothbrush out as the left hand slides in to pick up the toothpaste; both hands bring their items together in front of the body, the left-hand toothpaste tube is angled downward over the right-hand toothbrush and squeezed to dispense toothpaste onto the bristles, then the left hand lowers the tube while the right hand moves the toothbrush back toward the cup.
